_meta.claimPolicy: No service is considered fully supported unless implemented, contractTested, cloudValidated, and knownGaps is empty.
_meta.strictSurfacePolicy: Unknown Azure resource types and incomplete ARM requests must fail closed rather than returning fabricated success.

officialEmulators.label: Azurite
officialEmulators.notes: Official Microsoft storage emulator for Blob, Queue, and Table data planes.

officialEmulators.label: Azure Cosmos DB Emulator
officialEmulators.notes: Official local Cosmos DB development emulator. Use for data-plane app tests, not production parity claims.

officialEmulators.label: Azure Service Bus Emulator
officialEmulators.notes: Official container emulator. Requires a SQL Server sidecar and static config for entities.

officialEmulators.label: Azure Event Hubs Emulator
officialEmulators.notes: Official container emulator. Use for streaming/Kafka/AMQP scenarios, not Event Grid parity.

officialEmulators.label: Azure Functions Core Tools
officialEmulators.notes: Official local Functions runtime. GlobalStack models Function App resources and wires local settings.

officialEmulators.label: Azure App Configuration Emulator
officialEmulators.notes: Official local emulator for key/value and feature configuration workflows.

officialEmulators.label: Azure SignalR Local Emulator
officialEmulators.notes: Official dotnet tool for serverless SignalR scenarios only.

officialEmulators.label: Local PostgreSQL
officialEmulators.notes: Not an Azure emulator. Used behind an Azure Database for PostgreSQL control-plane facade.

officialEmulators.label: Local MySQL
officialEmulators.notes: Not an Azure emulator. Used behind an Azure Database for MySQL control-plane facade.

officialEmulators.label: Local Redis
officialEmulators.notes: Not an Azure emulator. Used behind an Azure Cache for Redis control-plane facade.

officialEmulators.label: Local File Share
officialEmulators.notes: Not an Azure emulator. Used for Azure Files metadata and POSIX-like local file persistence only.

officialEmulators.label: Local Analytics Store
officialEmulators.notes: Not an Azure emulator. Used for lightweight warehouse metadata and future DuckDB/PostgreSQL-backed query smoke tests.

officialEmulators.label: Local OCI Registry
officialEmulators.notes: Not an Azure emulator. Used behind an Azure Container Registry metadata facade.
